engine: statsmodels.MixedLM with vc_formula for nested REs
ar1: dropped (3-year overlap insufficient + facility REs absorb the persistence)

sample.dropped: 6 refinery facility-years (Galveston Bay Marathon + Exxon Beaumont)

bland_altman.interpretation: Negative slope = heteroscedasticity confirmed (peaker pattern; smaller facilities have wider CT divergence)

parent_vs_state.interpretation: State and parent each absorb 10-20% of variance when crossed; residual (facility) dominates

headline: Climate TRACE adds little independent emissions signal beyond CEMS gross load: beta_1 = 0.079 (CI [0.061, 0.097]) after controlling for log(gross_load_mwh) and nested random effects. The naive OLS slope of 0.69 reflected confounding between CT and operational intensity. Mechanism: CT relies on assumed capacity factors that fail systematically for low-capacity-factor units (peakers), overestimating their emissions by 1-3 orders of magnitude (Bland-Altman quintile analysis confirms).
